The '''Corondexx Blast Vest''' was a type of [[Blast vest/Legends|blast vest]] developed by [[Corondexx/Legends|Corondexx]]. In addition to the vest's material resistance, it also produced a localized high energy ion field which distorted and disrupted energy attacks. However, this feature was very power-intensive, and the on-board [[Power cell/Legends|power cells]] provided for only ten minutes of continuous use. The vest could alternatively be powered by capacitors built into the vest, which required a hour's charge but only provided two minutes' worth of protection. Some [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] took to modifying the vest to run on a small [[Power generator/Legends|power generator]] which increased the vest's time of operation at the expense of weight.
